'''June 2001 Parker tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Parker, CO on 2 June 2001. [[Brian Hunter]] won it. It is known from Brian Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2414">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-06-parker-co-6-2-01-into-the-unknownd2414/ parker-co-6-2-01-into-the-unknown], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 6 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-06-parker-co-6-2-01-into-the-unknownd2414/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 2 June 2001
* '''Site:''' Parker, CO
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Hunter]]
